heading: IPD Tower misses deadline again, pushed to March-April 2027
author: Arpit Basu /  Sep 21, 2026, 21:40 IST
paragraphs: Jaipur: The 17-storey IPD Tower at SMS Hospital is set to miss its year-end completion deadline again, with Jaipur Development Authority (JDA) officials now projecting completion by March-April 2027

The project, which was originally scheduled for completion in Nov 2024, has seen multiple deadline revisions.A senior JDA official said construction would take a few more months, after which the health department would need to procure and install equipment before the facility could become operational.“We are trying to open this tower by the end of this financial year, but it may take a few more months,” the official said.Officials said work had slowed after BJP govt came to power, with the project briefly facing the possibility of being shelved

Construction resumed after inter-departmental discussions but was subsequently affected by delays in the transfer of funds to JDA for expenses already incurred.The project has also become a political flashpoint, with former chief minister Ashok Gehlot recently accusing BJP govt and JDA of deliberately delaying it
BJP govt has not accepted the allegation.Gehlot had laid the foundation stone for the IPD Tower and Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences on April 5, 2022
